title: Inventory and item stacks
lua:
RikRenderItems()
RikUIBags:Show()
RikUI.Bags.Refresh()
RikRenderCenter(RikUIBags)
assert(RikUIBag0Slot2.rikIcon:GetTexture() == 134829, "Wrong potion icon")
assert(RikUIBag0Slot2.rikCount:GetText() == "5", "Missing stack count")
assertLua:
local left, right = RikUIBags.search:GetTextInsets()
assert(left == 16 and right == 20, "Search text must clear its icon and button")
assert(RikUIBags.bagHint:GetWidth() > 100, "Multiline label must fit its longest line")

title: Copying a conversation
lua:

RikRenderCenter(RikUIChatCopy)

title: The combat HUD
assertLua:
local ids = {}
for _, entry in ipairs(RikUI.Cooldowns.Entries) do ids[#ids + 1] = entry.id end
assert(table.concat(ids, ",") == "20287,20271,853,1022,633,498,679", "Unexpected strip order: " .. table.concat(ids, ","))
assert(RikUI.Cooldowns.Buttons[2].icon:GetTexture() == 135959, "Wrong Judgement icon")
assert(not RikUI.Cooldowns.Buttons[3].unknown:IsShown(), "Hammer of Justice cooldown must be readable")
